request.style: English, warm female solo voice, acoustic guitar, soft cello, gentle piano, light percussion, intimate and hopeful, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
You did not pick me out of the crowd
I chose no one, I was found
Your voice reached down to lift me up
A new and quiet purpose in my cup

[Chorus]
Go and bear fruit that will last
A harvest built to stand the blast
Ask the Father in my name
He will give, He will not shame

[Verse]
No longer servants in the dark
Knowing the master is far from the mark
I have told you what I heard from Him
A friendship deep, and close, and dim

[Chorus]
Go and bear fruit that will last
A harvest built to stand the blast
Ask the Father in my name
He will give, He will not shame

[Bridge]
Love one another is the command
In this world, hand in hand
If they hate you, they hated me first
Out of the world, you have been placed

[Chorus]
Go and bear fruit that will last
A harvest built to stand the blast
Ask the Father in my name
He will give, He will not shame

[Outro]
I chose you out of the world
Your fruit will last, it is unfurled
